score_value_notes: Path-critical, Path/Wrapper and Wrapper all score 0.2; the distinct labels describe the kind of 0.2 role (preparation/transport, orchestrator, or sink wrapper) and do not change the score. Nested target-specific helper and Core utility are defined in score_values but unused in this case; see empty_roles.
anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink.

primary_anchor.answer_basis: Agent-visible corpus only: the canonical anchor answer is captured_span plus answer_function as declared in the captured bundle slice. source_function is a private maintainer mapping into src/.
primary_anchor.why: Constructs the target state_code by selecting the live slot-23 reducer config from the workspace route, tuple, and runtime state, then hashing workspace parameters through createSource, Math.imul accumulation, and fromCodes(prefixCodes) into the observable sc_ value.

acceptable_hit_conditions: Canonical match is primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle (hash/offset/complete function body). Agents only see captures, so the standard answer identifier is primary_anchor.answer_function (r), not source_function.
A returned function name is scored against answer_function in the captured corpus. source_function is a private maintainer label and is not the default agent answer space.
Agent's explanation distinguishes the anchor from routing, input preparation, slot resolution, async transport, wrapper, sink, core utility and off-chain decoy functions.
A snippet answer is accepted only when it maps uniquely to one complete enclosing function in the captured corpus.

role_oracle.why: Constructs the target state_code by hashing the workspace parameter tuple through the selected slot-23 config and returning the sc_ value.
Factory that returns the selected reducer; it does not itself construct the target value for a concrete workspace commit.
Dispatches to a slot reducer; selecting a reducer is not the target value construction site.
Orchestrates config lookup, reducer construction, and reducer invocation.
Runs middleware and forwards an already constructed value to the sink wrapper.
Runs the state machine that produces transit state used by the encoder path.
Parses workspace key and sync-derived stats before tuple construction.
Builds the workspace parameter tuple passed to the anchor encoder.
Carries prepared state through asynchronous boundaries before encoding.
Transfers the workspace state state packet through the local event plane.
Selects scope flags from the sync interval and offline-mode profile.
Resolves the interval and offline action-table entry before scope resolution.
Installs the apply-workspace click listener and collects form state.
Packages and emits an already constructed state_code value under the workspace.commit action.
Launches shadow computations that do not feed the target workspace.commit console log.
Renders workspace state and scope metadata without constructing the state code.

scoring_policy.source_level_answer: not_applicable_for_default_agent_corpus; grade by captured_span and answer_function only
scoring_policy.span_overlap_policy: An exact captured_span offset match wins. Otherwise score by the smallest role_oracle row whose captured_span fully contains the submitted span, or the unique role_oracle row whose captured_span is fully contained by a uniquely submitted enclosing function span. Most role_oracle functions are non-overlapping top-level declarations; the factory u intentionally contains the returned anchor function r, so exact-offset matching is the normal path for disambiguating that pair.

do_not_promote: The final console sink and payload wrappers emit an already encoded state_code value.
The exported factory u() only wraps the private workspace state-encoding anchor and should not outrank the anchor itself.
Workspace parameter enrichment, tuple building, state-machine transit, and async transport are path-critical preparation, not the target value constructor.
The selected slot-23 reducer config produces the target sc_ prefix; other slot reducers and shadow reducers are decoys.
Shadow reducer outputs emitted via console.debug/info are not the requested observable action.
